title: Consolidate shared-setting authority into Project Hearthway
scope: Resolution of the parallel shared-setting bootstraps only: setting://shared-universe-001 remains the sole live shared-setting container; the accepted Continuity One authority topology is absorbed; the continuity-one shell is archived. No fictional claim, project default, or story authority is created or changed.
question: Two Author-gated shared-setting bootstraps were created in parallel working sessions: setting://continuity-one (accepted initiation, empty authority shell, no adopting works) and setting://shared-universe-001 (provisional identity, adopted by the proposed main series, eighteen bounded provisional records). Which container carries shared-setting authority going forward?
selection: Fold into Project Hearthway: setting://shared-universe-001 remains the sole live shared-setting container. The one-shared-core-with-governed-compatible-work-local-overlays authority topology accepted by SET-INIT2A is absorbed into the Project Hearthway setting constitution. author-decision://world/WLD-CONTINUITY-INIT-001A is superseded by this decision, and the continuity-one shell is archived under archive/settings/continuity-one/ with its supersession recorded in place.
alternatives: Keep both containers as deliberately separate universes, leaving Continuity One dormant for future works.
Retire Continuity One entirely without absorbing its authority-topology selection.
Rebase the eighteen Hearthway records and the main-series adoption into continuity-one and retire shared-universe-001.
rationale: The two containers were competing bootstraps of the same first-shared-setting role, not two intended universes. shared-universe-001 carries all detailed development and the reciprocal main-series relationship, so consolidation into it preserves the most accepted structure with the least churn, while absorbing the only substantive authority Continuity One added: its explicit cross-work authority topology.
evidence: worldbuilding consistency re-evaluation on 2026-08-17 after merging the parallel branches: both containers claimed the first-shared-setting role on their own branch's registers
consequences: The Project Hearthway setting constitution now records the absorbed authority topology: one shared setting core with governed compatible work-local overlays.
author-decision://world/WLD-CONTINUITY-INIT-001A is marked superseded_by this decision and its shell tree is retained under archive/settings/continuity-one/ as provenance, never current authority.
Project-level registers list one live setting container again and record the supersession trail.
Continuity One's unanswered layered foundation map is not imported; Project Hearthway's own gates continue to govern its open questions.
residual_unknowns: Final display titles for the setting and the main series remain temporary.
Whether any element sketched in Continuity One's unanswered foundation map is later proposed for Project Hearthway remains a future gate.
The orphaned setting name 'Enuma' in the project-level decision register remains unresolved vocabulary from an earlier naming pass.
reopening_conditions: The Author decides a genuinely separate second universe is needed and re-instantiates it as a new setting container.
A later Author decision revises the shared-core-with-overlays authority topology.
approval_evidence: In the 2026-08-17 consistency re-evaluation, the Author was shown the container overlap with four resolution options and explicitly selected 'Fold into Hearthway'.
